actual.titulo: Signs of a Psychopath • I Guess I'm a Maniac
actual.descripcion: I Guess I'm a Maniac | Detectives find a woman partially clothed and strangled to death in a wooded ditch in Florida; with no leads or suspects, her case goes cold; a surprise confession almost ten years later exposes a deviant sexual psychopath with a murderous fantasy.

siguiente.titulo: Signs of a Psychopath • I Wanted To Keep Her
siguiente.descripcion: I Wanted To Keep Her | When a grandmother vanishes, her grandson spins a twisted narrative about her demise and the disturbing location of her body inside a freezer; it doesn't take long for detectives to uncover the killer responsible, a parasitic psychopath.

lista.titulo: American Monster • Mom Is Always Right
lista.descripcion: Mom Is Always Right | A small-town marriage ends in tragedy when a man who uses a wheelchair discovers his loving wife of 10 years wants to end their marriage; a jury must determine if he acted in self-defense or murder.

lista.titulo: American Monster • Control Freak
lista.descripcion: Control Freak | Tricia and Galen Westfall appear to be the perfect couple; however, the reality is that Galen is jealous and controlling. When investigators find two bodies in a car crash, they uncover the grisly truth about a deadly relationship.

lista.titulo: American Monster • Drip, Drip!
lista.descripcion: Drip, Drip! | Nurse and private investigator Nikki and Jimmy Cappello are a dynamic duo, until Jimmy suddenly goes missing.

lista.titulo: Dead of Winter • The Widows of Winter
lista.descripcion: The Widows of Winter | Seventy-four-year-old widow Virginia Johannessen is shot dead in her home; then, another widow is murdered on the same street; as police unravel the truth, they discover they've made a chilling mistake.

lista.titulo: The Christmas Eve Massacre
lista.descripcion: Estreno ║ Four people die in a Christmas Eve massacre at a Florida furniture store, leaving owner Tommy Zeigler as the sole survivor. Fifty years later, lingering doubts about the case fuel a new investigation using modern technology to search for answers.

lista.titulo: The Christmas Tree Murder
lista.descripcion: A man forms a crush on his co-worker at a retail store selling seasonal decor; his inappropriate behavior gets him fired, turning his infatuation into a dangerous obsession; he follows her when her job sends her out of state.

lista.descripcion: 40 Years Winter | After Christmas shopping, 18-year-old Linda Velzy vanishes into upstate New York's frozen landscape; the primary suspect refuses to talk to detectives, so Linda's father hatches a plan, but temperatures are dropping, and time is running out.

lista.descripcion: Death by Eyedrops | Jessy Kurczewski calls police to report that she found Lynn Hernan dead in her recliner; the toxicology report shows a toxic ingredient in Lynn's blood and the authorities take a closer look at Jessy.

lista.titulo: Ken and Barbie Killers: The Lost Murder Tapes • The Murders
lista.descripcion: The Murders | Paul Bernardo and Karla Homolka embark on a passionate love affair; then, missing schoolgirls Leslie Mahaffy and Kristen French turn up dead, and a battered and bruised Homolka tells police Bernardo is the murderer.

lista.titulo: Ken and Barbie Killers: The Lost Murder Tapes • The Tapes
lista.descripcion: The Tapes | Karla Homolka tells the police that her husband, Bernardo, recorded videos of his assaults on schoolgirls Leslie Mahaffy and Kristen French; police are unable to find the tapes despite an exhaustive search.

lista.titulo: Ken and Barbie Killers: The Lost Murder Tapes • The Deal
lista.descripcion: The Deal | Paul Bernardo's lawyers find the videotapes of the assaults on Leslie Mahaffy and Kristen French; the tapes reveal Homolka is complicit in the crimes; unaware of this new information, prosecutors make a controversial deal with Homolka.

lista.titulo: Ken and Barbie Killers: The Lost Murder Tapes • The Trial
lista.descripcion: The Trial | Paul Bernardo is convicted of the murders of Leslie Mahaffy and Kristen French and sentenced to life in prison; Homolka is released after serving just 12 years for her part in the crimes; today, she walks around as a free citizen.

lista.titulo: The Green River Killer: Mind of a Monster
lista.descripcion: Victims of "The Green River Killer" are still being found; with access to hundreds of hours of unseen police footage, the shocking truth behind one of America's most prolific serial killers is revealed.
